items.title: GE Aerospace Buys Turbine Maker in Blow to SpaceX. These Stocks Could Benefit.
items.summary: Competition in the turbine blade manufacturing industry is heating up.  In that battle,  GE Aerospace  has seemingly gotten the edge on  SpaceX  leaving SpaceX CEO Elon Musk with an interesting choice.  Musk made waves in the aerospace industry recently when he suggested that his rocket and AI firm could get into the business of casting turbine blades.

items.title: GE to Buy Consolidated Precision Products for $11.75B
items.summary: Bloomberg's Kiel Porter joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." GE Aerospace agreed to buy castings manufacturer Consolidated Precision Products from Warburg Pincus and Berkshire Partners for $11.75 billion, a deal that will significantly expand the jet-engine manufacturer's capacity for the critical components.
